If output capture is allowed, pull the assistant's final raw text and truncate it.

summary.desc: Maps a normalized attempt terminal to a run outcome: aborted, blocked, error or completed.
algo: Project the terminal into flat flags.
Timed out, externally aborted or aborted: "aborted".
Prompt error from hook:before_agent_run: "blocked" by before_agent_run.
Any other prompt error source: "error" carrying promptError.
Otherwise: "completed".

notes.text: Check order is the priority: an abort wins over a hook block, which wins over an error.

functions.name: emitAgentHarnessRunCompleted
functions.signature: function emitAgentHarnessRunCompleted(params: { harness: AgentHarness; attemptParams: AgentHarnessAttemptParams; result: EmbeddedRunAttemptResult; startedAt: number; trace?: DiagnosticTraceContext; }…

summary.desc: Emits harness.run.completed with outcome, classification, item lifecycle and the gated final answer.
algo: Derive the run completion and project the terminal.
Harness outcome: timed out becomes "timed_out", blocked becomes "error", otherwise the run outcome.
On error, take the message from terminal.promptError (a classified, non-thrown failure).
Build gated answer text (no prompt) from currentAttemptAssistant, else currentAttemptCompletedAssistant.
Emit with resultClassification, yieldDetected (if boolean) and a copy of itemLifecycle.

notes.text: The same timeout reads "aborted" on run.completed but "timed_out" here; a hook block reads "blocked" there and "error" here.

functions.name: createAgentHarnessLifecycleDiagnostics
functions.signature: function createAgentHarnessLifecycleDiagnostics( harness: AgentHarness, params: AgentHarnessAttemptParams, finalizing = false, )

summary.desc: Opens the harness span and returns a controller for phases, the child run span, failure and completion.
algo: Capture startedAt and the active trace; emit harness.run.started with the gated prompt.
Subscribe to agent commentary diagnostics (unsubscribe is returned).
createRunTrace makes a child trace only for non-"openclaw" harnesses with an active trace; finalizing mode creates it up front.
startAgentRun: create the run trace if needed and emit run.started.
run(execute): execute inside the run trace context when there is one.
fail(error): record the preflight owner (attempts only), emit harness.run.error with the current phase, then run.completed as error.

notes.text: Phase starts at "prepare", so a throw before the send step is attributed to preparation.
If a failure happens before startAgentRun, no run.* events go out; only harness.run.error does.

functions.name: runAgentHarnessLifecycleAttempt
functions.signature: export async function runAgentHarnessLifecycleAttempt( harness: AgentHarness, params: AgentHarnessAttemptParamsV2, execute: (params: AgentHarnessAttemptParamsV2) => Promise<AgentHarnessAttemptResult>…

summary.desc: Entry point: runs one harness attempt inside full diagnostics, then classifies and normalizes the result.
algo: Create lifecycle diagnostics (opens the harness span).
Phase prepare: assert context-engine support, then start the child run span.
Phase send: run execute(params) in the run trace (default: harness.runAttempt).
Phase resolve: without classify, just tag agentHarnessId; with it, drop any previous classification, reclassify, keep only non-"ok" labels.
Normalize to the canonical terminal shape, keep TTS provenance from the raw result, add the fallback trace.
On a throw: fail() emits the error events, then rethrow. Always unsubscribe.
On success: emit run.completed (prompt and answer) then harness.run.completed, and return.

notes.text: Completion events fire after the finally block, so a throwing emitter cannot trigger fail() and double-report.

functions.name: runAgentHarnessLifecycleFinalization
functions.signature: export async function runAgentHarnessLifecycleFinalization( harness: AgentHarness, params: AgentHarnessSettledTurnFinalizationAttemptParams<AgentHarnessAttemptParamsV2>, execute: () => Promise<AgentH…

summary.desc: Entry point: runs a settled-turn finalization under diagnostics, treating an empty result as a normal outcome.
algo: Create diagnostics in finalizing mode (run trace up front) and emit run.started.
Phase send: run execute() in the run trace.
Phase resolve: validate with assertSettledTurnFinalizationResult, giving outcome "answered".
EmptySettledTurnFinalizationError is caught and becomes outcome "empty" with its result.
Add the fallback trace to the inner result if it has none.
Emit run.completed and harness.run.completed (zeroed itemLifecycle), return the outcome.
Any other error: fail() and rethrow. Always unsubscribe.

notes.text: startAgentRun() sits outside the try, so if it throws, the commentary subscription is never unsubscribed.
Completion events are emitted inside the try. If one throws, fail() sends a second run.completed, this time as error.
An "empty" finalization still reports outcome "completed" in both events.

types.name: AgentHarnessLifecycleFinalizationOutcome
types.summary: What the finalization entry point returns: answered or empty, plus the prepared result.

types.name: AgentHarnessLifecyclePhase
types.summary: The step a failure is attributed to (prepare, send, resolve), borrowed from the harness.run.error event type.

types.name: AgentRunCompletion
types.summary: Internal summary of how a run ended, fed to run.completed.

types.name: AgentRunMessageContent
types.summary: Optional prompt and answer text attached to completion events as private data.

overview.text: Wraps every agent-harness execution in diagnostics. Each run gets an outer `harness.run` span and, for any harness other than `openclaw`, a child `run` span. Along the way it normalizes harness results to the canonical terminal-outcome contract and applies the harness's own classification. Prompt and answer text only leave through the private-data channel, and only when the content-capture policy allows it.
Reads diagnostic events from stdin and forwards them to an HTTP collector in batches of up to 100, or every 2 seconds.

# openclaw

An agent runtime with pluggable harnesses, chat channels and a diagnostics pipeline.

## Layout

- `src/agents`: harnesses, the embedded runner and agent tools.
- `src/infra`: diagnostic events, trace contexts and content policy.
- `src/gateway`: the HTTP and WebSocket entry points.
- `src/channels`: adapters for Slack, Discord and the terminal.
- `tools/relay`: a small Go service that forwards diagnostic events.

## Diagnostics

Every harness run is wrapped by `runAgentHarnessLifecycleAttempt`, which emits
`harness.run.started`, `run.started`, `run.completed` and `harness.run.completed`.
Prompt and answer text are only attached when the content-capture policy allows it.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
```
